development_repositories.name: linux-camera-preparation
development_repositories.status: Camera-DT image25 RAM booted on compiled39 kernel. Native CCI probe/reset,preflight,2560-byte and two65536-byte reads match independent GPIO capture; shared supply and CCI runtime suspend/resume/clock gating pass for these reads. Controller unbind,error/system-PM,sensor streaming and CAMSS remain unqualified.

development_repositories.name: linux-display-power
development_repositories.status: Panel DCS ordering plus shared CPU-PLL L8 always-on fix. Exact39 RAM image26 with original MSM and fixed panel module: owner-confirmed RGB before/after first full CRTC cycle; three further cycles complete with MDSS/IOMMU control auto. No temporary supply/clock hold module. Transient MDP error04000000 observed during repeated enable; full PM,reliability and installed Nura qualification remain open.

development_repositories.name: linux-display-start
development_repositories.status: Bounded MDSS population PM reference and optional DSI bus-clock query reference. W=1/checkpatch pass; clean exact44 module starts without userspace holds and5s off/on passes, but repeat startup resets intermittently. Not a complete default-PM fix; not in exported r1 Nura APK.
